# Spinnaker Pediatric Dentistry

> > Specialized pediatric dental care in Salem, Oregon using advanced laser technology and gentle techniques for children's oral health.

Spinnaker Pediatric Dentistry is a Salem-based practice led by Dr. Sean Cooper and Dr. Amanda Day, offering comprehensive pediatric dental services with innovative technologies like laser dentistry and EZCrowns. The practice emphasizes anxiety-reducing techniques and preventive care for children of all ages.

## Key Topics

- Pediatric Dentistry
- Laser Dentistry
- Preventive Care
- Dental Crowns
- Cavity Prevention
- Gentle Dentistry
- Children's Oral Health
- Salem, Oregon
- Dr. Sean Cooper
- Dr. Amanda Day
- Bioclear Technology
- EZCrowns by Sprig
- HIPAA Compliance
- Family Dentistry
- Tooth Restoration

## Core Services

- [Pediatric Dentistry](https://spinpedo.com/pediatric-dentistry): Main pediatric dentistry services including crowns, sealants, fillings, and preventive care.
- [Laser Dentistry](https://spinpedo.com/laser-dentistry): Laser dentistry technology for cavity removal, pulp therapy, and low-stress pediatric treatments.
- [Your Child's First Visit](https://spinpedo.com/childs-first-visit): Guide for children's first dental visit using Tell, Show, Do approach to reduce anxiety.
